# Claude Remote

> > Control Claude Code from your iPhone or iPad — run AI coding agents remotely on your Mac with zero-cloud architecture.

Claude Remote is a distributed development platform that enables mobile control of Claude Code sessions running on Mac. Built on tmux, WebSocket, and Cloudflare Tunnel, it provides secure remote access to AI coding agents with end-to-end encryption and local-only execution.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code remote control
- iPhone/iPad mobile development
- tmux session management
- WebSocket real-time communication
- Zero-cloud architecture
- Cloudflare Tunnel networking
- iOS lifecycle handling
- AI coding agent monitoring
- End-to-end encryption
- macOS server setup
- Session persistence
- Mobile approval UX
- Remote development workflow
- Full-stack app building
- Long-running task management
